title: KozaCore
description: A sleek client-side utility mod for Fabric 1.21 featuring a custom UI, HUD elements, and quality-of-life enhancements.
body:
KozaCore

KozaCore is a client-side visual and utility mod for Minecraft 1.21, built on the Fabric loader. It focuses on enhancing the user experience with a sleek purple interface, highly customizable HUD elements, and a variety of quality-of-life modules.
🛠 Features
🎨 Visuals & UI

    Purple ClickGUI: A stylish, intuitive interface to manage all your modules.

    Custom Main Menu: A redesigned home screen for a fresh look.

    Drag HUD: Freely move your HUD elements anywhere on the screen.

    Fullbright: Enhances visibility in dark environments.

    Time Changer: Adjust the world time locally to your preference.

    Swing Animation: Customizable sword/tool swing animations.

📊 Information HUD

    Armor HUD: Tracks the durability of your equipped armor.

    Potion HUD: Displays active potion effects and their duration.

    Keystrokes: Shows your key presses (WASD, CPS) on screen.

    FPS / Ping / Direction: Keep track of your performance and orientation.

⚙️ Utilities & Performance

    Keybind Manager: Easily bind modules to any key via commands.

    Auto Reconnect: Automatically attempts to rejoin a server after a disconnect.

    FPS Boost & NoRender: Improves performance by disabling unnecessary particles and rendering overhead.

    Zoom: Built-in cinematic zoom for better visibility at a distance.

    NameProtection: Hide your real nickname or set a custom one locally.

⌨️ Commands

    Set custom nickname: /kozacore name <nick>

    Bind module to key: /kozacore bind <module> <key>

        Example: /kozacore bind Zoom C

    Clear bind: /kozacore bind <module> none

📋 Requirements & Installation

    Version: Minecraft 1.21

    Loader: Fabric Loader

    Required API: Fabric API

    Java: 21

Note: KozaCore is a client-side mod. While many features are visual or quality-of-life improvements, always check individual server rules before using utility modules.
